label: Bible Study
prompt: But ye, beloved, _____ up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
verse: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
note: Jude's construction advice — build yourselves up on your most holy faith.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not _____.
verse: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
note: God's open treasury: rain in season, work blessed, and the rare promise to lend and never borrow.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he found a new _____ of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
verse: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
note: Samson's weapon of choice was a fresh jawbone of a donkey — he even wrote a little victory poem about it.

label: Deep Water
verse: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
note: Part of Paul's unity creed — seven 'ones' in three verses, from one body to one God and Father.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the _____' den.
verse: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
note: In the peaceable kingdom a weaned child reaches into the 'cockatrice' den — the KJV's name for a deadly serpent.
